child.text:
[{"insert":"Bench Press

The barbell bench press is the primary horizontal press today. Keep the shoulder blades pinched together and down throughout the set.  This protects the shoulder and creates a more stable pressing platform. The 20X1 tempo means a controlled descent, no pause at the bottom, then drive. The set finishes with a max unbroken drop set at Set 1 weight, so by the time you reach it, the chest and triceps have already climbed through three progressively harder sets. Reps drop across the odd weeks, so the weight goes up each time it returns.
"}]
